Noah (FinOps): Spot check found ~$27,640 charged to project 'orphan-preempt' overnight 2026-03-18 01:30-03:00 UTC. Looks like fallback labeling took effect. ops-bot: Alert: Billing anomaly for BA-12345 126: project concentration exceeded threshold. Priya (Billing Ops): Can someone grab the export rows and ledger ids? I want to see if these are preemptible credits or normal usage. Eli (Infra): Quick extract uploaded: https://console.cloud.google.com/billing/exports/BA-12345?file=orphan-2026-03-18.csv. Many rows have label_gpu_team = "" and label_preempt_label = "orphan-preempt". Jasmine (CostOps): That matches the new preemptible fallback flag from the experiment. If pod labels fail, they were getting routed to orphan-preempt. Noah (FinOps): Impact to team budgets? Jasmine (CostOps): Two small teams hit overrun thresholds; recommend retro allocation up to $30k. Priya (Billing Ops): Please provide mapping CSV with ledger_id, suggested owner, and cost. Eli (Infra): SQL I ran (trimmed):

SELECT invoice_month, project_id, label_gpu_team, label_preempt_label, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM `billing_export.gcp_costs`
WHERE invoice_month='2026-03' AND DATE(usage_start_time)='2026-03-18'
  AND (label_gpu_team IS NULL OR label_gpu_team='')
  AND label_preempt_label='orphan-preempt'
GROUP BY invoice_month, project_id, label_gpu_team, label_preempt_label;

Eli (Infra): Result shows project_id=orphan-preempt cost=27640.12. Priya (Billing Ops): Opening ticket BILL-4632 to track manual reallocation and automation. ops-bot: Ticket BILL-4632 created, assigned to Priya, Eli, Jasmine. Noah (FinOps): Approved to reallocate up to $30k pending mapping and QA. Priya (Billing Ops): copying memo template 126 fill and return: - invoice_ref: 2026-03-18-BA-12345 - affected_ledger_ids: [..] - proposed_owner: team_name - amount: numeric - reason: fallback flag matched when pod labels missing Eli (Infra): I'll assemble mapping and include kubelet log timestamps so ML infra can correlate. Jasmine (CostOps): Add an alert: trigger if >$2.5k lands in 'orphan-preempt' in 2 hours. Priya (Billing Ops): Once mapping validated I'll run reallocation and post journal refs here. Noah (FinOps): Thanks all. Reallocation approved, ticket open, automation alert requested. :white_check_mark:
